item.title: Criminal proceedings halted for alleged Midway District killer
item.description: The suspect is the same man who rushed the stage at Petco Park in 2015 when singer Taylor Swift was performing a concert.

item.title: Fresh sandwiches and Italian products abound at Gusto Deli & Bistro in PB
item.description: The store sells its hard-to-find Italian products and, as of earlier this year, the kitchen started serving up authentic Italian sandwiches and pastas to-go.

item.title: San Diego lawmakers push congressional authority ahead of Iran war powers vote
item.description: Members of San Diego’s congressional delegation issued statements as the U.S. House prepared to vote on a war powers resolution related to military action in Iran.

item.title: Tiempos de San Diego 02/26: Distrito escolar en crisis
item.description: Esta actualización trata sobre Distrito Escolar de San Ysidro en crisis y si recibe subsidio de vivienda, tenga en cuenta esta información

item.title: Tiempos de San Diego 02/27: Espectáculo de flores
item.description: Esta actualización trata sobre espectáculo de flores y muchos colores, Escondido mantiene su contrato con ICE y difícil encontrar trabajo

item.title: Review: Symphony’s chorus delivers full-bodied polish for Brahms ‘Requiem’
item.description: Rehearsed to a full-bodied polish, and led with a sure hand by Music Director Rafael Payare, the San Diego Symphony Chorus confidently held the spotlight.

item.title: Supreme Court rules in school gender disclosure policy stemming from Escondido lawsuit
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court Monday blocked California school policies that prohibit teachers from sharing students' preferred gender identities with their parents, a ruling that stemmed from a lawsuit originally filed by two Escondido middle school teachers.

item.title: Introducing Tiempos de San Diego
item.description: We're excited to announce our new initiative: a daily news round up, in Spanish, delivered through WhatsApp.

item.title: Grab a jacket – Cooler temps, chance of rain in San Diego County this week
item.description: A low-pressure system moving inland to the north will keep temperatures cooler across San Diego County Tuesday, with gusty winds lingering in the mountains and deserts.

item.title: SD Unified expands free transitional kindergarten; apply by March 22
item.description: San Diego Unified School District leaders Monday announced that free transitional kindergarten is being expanded for the next school year with the addition of nine new classrooms and 180 additional enrollment seats.
